function.name: repository_context
function.description: Opt-in local repository grounding for a substantive code task. Requires operator-configured BACKENDPRO_WORKSPACE; never guesses a root or crawls directories. Select explicit tracked files or supply saved-file editor locations with revision/hashes. Skip trivial edits. Local AST calls are unresolved syntax, not semantic call-graph proof. function.description: Expand a bpme evidence ID returned by evidence-format search into its complete local source row and immutable content binding. No network access. An edited or removed record fails explicitly; repeat the search. This opt-in detail response is not character-packed.

function.name: search
function.description: Retrieve cited backend guidance for transaction boundaries, idempotency, retries, schema migrations, and operational failure handling. Use when external engineering guidance can affect correctness; skip typos, link fixes, and self-contained local edits. Domain is auto-detected if omitted. Raw results are the default; compact returns bounded, source-linked evidence with explicit gaps, not a confidence score. BM25 stays the offline default. Optional hybrid/semantic engines and reranking report requested/effective execution and fallbacks. Explicit scopes are never widened; diagnostics exposes routing hints only.

min_score.description: Exclude pre-rerank scores <= this: BM25, cosine similarity or RRF, depending on effective engine. Not confidence.

engine.description: Optional model engines require backendpro[semantic]; missing dependencies fall back explicitly.

candidate_pool.description: Candidates per scope before final selection; >= max_results. Defaults to max(20,max_results) with reranking, otherwise max_results.

diagnostics.description: Include engine, scope and candidate diagnostics even for default BM25.

expand.description: Apply existing synonym expansion to lexical retrieval.

max_age_months.description: Exclude stale rows before candidate selection; rows with missing dates are kept.

constraints.description: Existing constraint preferences, e.g. cloud=gcp,cost=low. Prioritize satisfied preferences within the candidate pool; unknown metadata is not a hard exclusion.

max_chars.description: Evidence-format JSON character budget including metadata, excluding transport envelopes. Whole units only.

function.name: compare

function.name: decide
function.description: Recommend backend candidates for a requirement with constraints such as consistency, throughput, cloud, and cost. Uses the existing decision engine; check assumptions and trade-offs, not just rank. Use search for a focused fact instead.

requirement.description: Natural-language requirement (e.g. 'message broker for 100k msg/s, exactly once, on AWS').

function.name: adr

function.name: design

description.description: System description with optional scale numbers (e.g. 'URL shortener serving 10M reads/day').
